title: Succession Certificate: When Do You Really Need One?
desc: A succession certificate under Section 372, Indian Succession Act, 1925 lets heirs claim a deceased relative's bank deposits and shares in Uttarakhand.
keywords: succession certificate vs legal heir certificate
why: Families in Haldwani and Nainital often find a bank or company refuses to release a deceased relative's deposits or shares without a court-issued succession certificate, and confuse it with the simpler legal heir certificate.
keyPoints: A succession certificate under Section 372 of the Indian Succession Act, 1925 lets heirs collect a deceased person's debts and securities, such as bank balances and shares.
It is granted by the District Judge, not the revenue department, and covers only movable assets, not land or houses.
A legal heir certificate from the tehsil is a different, simpler document, mainly used for pension, gratuity and service dues.
The court issues a public notice before granting the certificate, so anyone else with a claim can object first.

sections.h: What is a succession certificate, and when do you need one?
p: A succession certificate is a court order under Section 372 of the Indian Succession Act, 1925 that lets a deceased person's heirs collect debts and securities, such as bank deposits, fixed deposits, shares and provident fund dues. In Haldwani and Nainital, the petition is filed before the District Judge's court. Banks and companies usually ask for this certificate before releasing funds when there is no nominee and no will.

Any person claiming to be an heir, such as a spouse, child or parent of the deceased, can petition for the certificate. The petition must state the time and place of death, the family members or other heirs, and the debts and securities for which the certificate is sought.

sections.h: How is it different from a legal heir certificate?
p: A legal heir certificate is issued by the tehsil or revenue authorities, not a court. It is simpler and quicker to get, and is commonly accepted for a government employee's pension, gratuity, provident fund and similar service dues.

It is not the same proof as a succession certificate. Because a legal heir certificate is issued without a court notice inviting objections, banks and companies often insist on a succession certificate before releasing larger sums. Neither document gives title to immovable property; land and houses pass through inheritance and must separately be mutated (dakhil kharij) in the revenue records.

sections.h: What is the process to get one?
p: The heir files a petition before the District Judge under Section 372, listing the deceased's debts and securities. Under Section 373, the court issues a notice so that any other person with an interest in the estate can raise an objection before the certificate is granted.

If no one objects, or objections are resolved, the court grants the certificate, and a court fee is payable based on the value of the assets involved. If the amount in a bank account is small, some banks allow withdrawal through an indemnity bond instead, so it is worth asking the bank first.

whatToDo: Collect the death certificate, proof of the family tree, and details of all bank accounts, fixed deposits and shares before filing.
Ask the bank or company whether it will release the amount through a nomination or indemnity bond, which can avoid the need for a court petition.
If you only need the document for a government employee's pension or service dues, check with the tehsil whether a legal heir certificate is enough.
Take legal advice on your own facts, since whether you need a succession certificate depends on the asset, its value and the institution's own rules.

hi.title: उत्तराधिकार प्रमाण पत्र: आपको यह कब चाहिए?
keyPoints: भारतीय उत्तराधिकार अधिनियम, 1925 की धारा 372 के तहत उत्तराधिकार प्रमाण पत्र से वारिस मृतक के बैंक खाते और शेयर जैसी चल संपत्ति पा सकते हैं।
यह जिला न्यायाधीश द्वारा जारी किया जाता है, राजस्व विभाग द्वारा नहीं, और केवल चल संपत्ति पर लागू होता है, जमीन-मकान पर नहीं।
तहसील से मिलने वाला वारिस प्रमाण पत्र अलग और सरल दस्तावेज़ है, जो मुख्यतः पेंशन व सेवा लाभ के लिए काम आता है।
प्रमाण पत्र देने से पहले अदालत सार्वजनिक सूचना जारी करती है ताकि कोई और दावेदार आपत्ति दर्ज कर सके।
